name: Alice in Kenkou Land
source:
This is a strip-based RPG where losing means getting completely undressed.

One day, Alice stumbles into a mysterious bathhouse. The strange residents of the bathhouse try to strip her of her clothes, leading to a series of bizarre encounters.

From enduring the sauna to chaotic orgies in the open-air baths, can Alice escape this strange bathhouse unscathed?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ345897.html/]dlsite[/url]]
